title: EwCreate Modpack
description: A modpack with Create stuff, Farmer's Delight and more!
body:
# ⚙️ EwCreate Modpack

*Spin up the gears. Stock the pantry. The world is yours to build.*

EwCreate is a **casual Create modpack** for Fabric 1.20.1 - built for players who want the 
full engineering experience without overwhelming complexity. Automate your world, cook hearty 
meals, explore brand-new content backported straight to 1.20.1, and make every corner of your 
base feel alive. Whether you're a seasoned Create veteran or just getting started with your 
first contraption - this pack is for you.

---

## ⚙️ Create & Addons

The heart of EwCreate. Build intricate contraptions, set up fully automated production lines, 
and engineer your way through survival. The pack includes a curated selection of Create addons 
- including **Create: Recipe Extensions** - that expand what's possible without bloating the 
experience. Every addon here was chosen to *add* to Create, not distract from it.

---

## 🍖 Farmer's Delight

Survival food got a serious upgrade. Grow a proper farm, harvest new crops, and prepare 
full meals that actually make a difference. Farmer's Delight fits naturally alongside Create 
- automate your crop harvesting, set up a cooking line, and never go hungry mid-build again.

---

## 🌸 The Garden Awakens & 🪨 The Copper Age

Two of Minecraft's most exciting recent updates - **backported to Fabric 1.20.1** so you don't 
have to wait. Wander into the hauntingly beautiful pale garden biome, or dive into new copper 
crafting content that adds a whole new layer to early and mid-game progression. Fresh content, 
familiar version.

---

## 🖼️ Immersive Paintings

Your base deserves more than blank walls. With Immersive Paintings, you can place fully custom 
paintings anywhere in your world - turn your factory floor into a gallery, your bedroom into 
a masterpiece, or just add some life to an otherwise empty hallway.

---

## 🎒 Sophisticated Backpacks

Step away from the base and actually explore. Sophisticated Backpacks gives you upgradeable, 
organised storage on the go - so you can gather resources, go on long trips, and come back 
with everything you need. Travel light. Carry more.

---

## 🌍 Built for Solo & Multiplayer

EwCreate runs smoothly whether you're playing alone or with a group of friends on a server. 
Optimised, stable, and ready to go right out of the box.

🔗 **Discord:** [discord.gg/PQJeWmHpEk](https://discord.gg/PQJeWmHpEk)

*So, let the Create journey begin!* ⚙️
